input: Registered exact checked field model and composition boundary from the same checked graph; typed-query/v1 contracts; explicit source Entity data rows and scalar formal inputs
representation: Descriptor-bound typed arrow returning an eagerly consumed frozen read-model array; separately hashed provider; no storage adapter, domain factory or runtime expression interpreter
value_semantics: Reuse the checked structured value algebra: exact UInt64, String and Bool, named Entity identity and Value Object value equality, Enum and sum tags/payloads, optional null, ordered duplicate-preserving lists and unique canonically ordered sets
filter: Exact operand type equality; eq uses the declared value equality; lt/lte/gt/gte require scalar operands. String order is JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit order, UInt64 order is exact numeric, Bool order is false before true. No implicit unwrapping, coercion, reference lookup or mixed-type comparisons
ordering: Declared required scalar field only, ascending or descending; stable ties preserve input row occurrences; no implicit order on optional, structured or collection values
projection: Exactly the declared field list and typed shapes; deep immutable normalized data, not a newly constructed Entity or invariant validation. Missing optional fields normalize to null. Nonprojected source fields do not leak
perimeter: Validate every declared parameter and complete source row, including unused fields and rows later filtered out; no accessor evaluation or caller mutation; reject sparse, hidden, extra, symbolic or inherited data; no hostile Proxy or modified realm purity claim
preservation: Old source schemas, configuration blockers, profiles, Rule emitted bytes, public defaults and legacy Query rendering remain unchanged
